joanne.writer: Quick PR up to tighten the tool-calling quickstart. Lightweight goals: single compact SDK example, show JSON-schema shape + nullability, and a short note about fallbacks. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3499

mike.sdk: Can you paste the snippet so I can sanity-check the SDK copy? aiming for 1 call, minimal boilerplate.

joanne.writer: Yep. Intention: demonstrate a tool named `price.lookup`, JSON schema, and a simple fallback comment. Kept it intentionally tiny.

joanne.writer: ```json
{
  "tool": "price.lookup",
  "input": {"sku": "RDW-100"},
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"price":{"type":["number","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["price"]}
}
```

elaine.eng: Looks clear. One note: allow currency to be null because some legacy services omit it. Also add one-liner about streaming = off for this snippet.

joanne.writer: Done \- updated schema to allow null for currency and added `(assumes non-streaming response)` to the comment.

mark.prod: Heads-up: the PR also needs two link fixes we found in the migrate guide: `/guides/structured-output` should be `/docs/structured-output` and a stale anchor for `#parsing-patterns`.

joanne.writer: Fixed both in the PR and added a short paragraph describing the fallback approach: parse raw text -> regex capture -> coerce into schema object.

qa-bot: link-checker: fixed 2 broken links. docs-lint: passed. snippets-smoke: passed.

mike.sdk: Approving now. small nit: add a one-line example regex comment like `// fallback: /price: ([0-9.]+)/` so readers can copy quickly.

joanne.writer: Added the regex comment and pushed. Thanks everyone, will merge after changelog entry.

elaine.eng: Thx  leaving a note in the Dedicated runbook about the streaming caveat.

joanne.writer: Merged and backported to stable. Closing thread. :rocket:
